title: Fourier expansion of a translated function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $z,x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The value of $f$ translated by $z$ at $x$ is $\sum_{\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n}\chi_\gamma(z)\,\widehat f(\gamma)\,\chi_\gamma(x)$, where $\chi_\gamma$ is the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$ and $\widehat f(\gamma)$ is the corresponding Fourier coefficient.
